name: Linear-WordPress Integration
description: Connect Linear issues to WordPress posts. Search, create, and link issues and posts directly from Claude conversations.
author: LightSpeed WP

issues.name: Linear Issues
issues.description: Search, view, and create Linear issues

content.name: WordPress Content
content.description: Search, view, and create WordPress posts

linking.name: Issue-to-Content Linking
linking.description: Link Linear issues to WordPress posts for tracking relationships

requiredEnvVars.name: LINEAR_API_KEY
requiredEnvVars.description: Linear API key from Settings > API > Personal API keys

requiredEnvVars.name: WORDPRESS_AUTH_USER
requiredEnvVars.description: WordPress username for REST API authentication

requiredEnvVars.name: WORDPRESS_AUTH_PASSWORD
requiredEnvVars.description: WordPress application password (NOT regular password - create in Users > App Passwords)
examples: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx

optionalEnvVars.name: USER_EMAIL
optionalEnvVars.description: Optional email for audit logging when creating/linking items

steps.title: Get Linear API Key
steps.instructions:
1. Go to Linear Settings > API
2. Click 'Create personal API key'
3. Copy and save the key
4. Paste into LINEAR_API_KEY environment variable

steps.title: Setup WordPress REST API Access
steps.instructions:
1. In WordPress admin, go to Users > Your Profile
2. Scroll to 'Application Passwords'
3. Create new application password for 'Linear MCP'
4. Copy username and password
5. Set WORDPRESS_AUTH_USER and WORDPRESS_AUTH_PASSWORD
6. REST API URL is typically: https://your-site.com/wp-json/wp/v2

steps.title: Verify Connection
steps.instructions:
1. In Claude, run 'get_linear_teams' - should return your teams
2. Run 'search_wordpress_posts' with a common term
3. If both work, you're ready to use the integration!

useCases.title: Document Bug Fixes
useCases.description: Find completed bug fixes in Linear and create blog posts to document the solution
useCases.workflow:
1. Search Linear for closed bugs
2. Get issue details
3. Create WordPress post
4. Link the two together

useCases.title: Track Feature Requests
useCases.description: Create documentation for new features and link them to the original feature requests
useCases.workflow:
1. Search for feature request issues
2. Create feature announcement post
3. Link post to issue
4. Keep team updated

useCases.title: Content-Driven Development
useCases.description: Create blog posts and automatically create follow-up tasks in Linear
useCases.workflow:
1. Browse WordPress posts
2. Identify gaps needing implementation
3. Create Linear issues for development
4. Link everything together

useCases.title: Customer Communication
useCases.description: Link support tickets to relevant documentation
useCases.workflow:
1. Search for relevant help content
2. Link to customer-facing issues
3. Provide better support context

examplePrompts: Search for 'authentication' issues in Linear and show me the high priority ones
Create a WordPress post about our latest security update and link it to the issue
Find all blog posts tagged 'API' and search for related Linear issues
Create a new issue in our Engineering team about implementing the feature we just blogged about
Show me all posts in draft status and create Linear issues to complete them
Link our latest product announcement to the launch issue in Linear

multiMcpSupport.description: Works seamlessly with other MCPs like Zendesk, GitHub, Slack
examples: Use with Zendesk MCP: Link customer tickets to both Linear issues and WordPress documentation
Use with GitHub MCP: Link GitHub PRs to WordPress releases and Linear milestones
Use with Slack MCP: Announce new posts and issues from within Slack conversations

dataHandling.storage: All data stays in your Linear workspace and WordPress site. No data is stored by this MCP.
dataHandling.privacy: API credentials are handled securely and never logged. All connections use HTTPS.
dataHandling.caching: The MCP does not cache data - each tool call retrieves fresh information.

troubleshooting.linearNotConnecting:
1. Verify LINEAR_API_KEY is set correctly
2. Check API key hasn't expired
3. Verify permissions in Linear (Settings > API)
4. Check network connectivity
troubleshooting.wordPressNotConnecting:
1. Verify WORDPRESS_REST_API_URL is correct format
2. Confirm username and password are correct
3. Check that REST API is enabled (Plugins > should have REST API)
4. Ensure user has REST API permissions
troubleshooting.toolsNotAppearing:
1. Restart Claude
2. Verify environment variables are set
3. Check MCP connection status
4. Refresh browser
